title: SQLite
description: A SQLite database in a file next to the app. Schema changes are migration files in `migrations/`, which the app applies itself when it starts, so the runner has no step after a merge. A migration that is on the base branch is frozen all the same: a database that ran it will not run it again. Sessions use a database file of their own for tests and for trying a change.
choose: The data lives in a SQLite file on the machine the app runs on.
